execution_contract.generated_ids: target database only; never source IDs
execution_contract.before_updates: re-select exactly one row by semantic key; compare all before values and schema revision; reject drift
execution_contract.repeat: desired row already present => SKIP; do not increment revision on no-op
execution_contract.atomicity: one transaction after explicit review; dependency order groups/families, positions/specialties, aliases/links
execution_contract.protected: no writes to employees, assignments, orders, snapshots, templates; retain target-only dictionary rows
execution_contract.rollback: capture per-row before/after in external release artifact; rollback before commit on any mismatch; after commit restore only if current matches recorded after; delete a newly inserted dictionary row only after checking all inbound references, otherwise manual decision
